newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine state bank vault hides load of cocaine.
newsitem.headline: Argentine state bank vault hides load of cocaine.

text.p: Argentine congressmen who were investigating a huge customs fraud discovered about 1.5 tonnes of cocaine on Tuesday in safety deposit boxes rented by the Customs Office in the National Bank.

Members of the lower house's Criminal Investigations Committee said the confiscated drugs, with a street value of $150 million, should have been burned five days after seizure but some had been there in bags and suitcases since 1984.

Congressman Mario Das Neves of the ruling Peronist Party told reporters he blamed the Customs Office for "leaving deposit boxes with this quantity of drugs in the hands of a person who takes the key home and keeps a book on it that looks like a neighbourhood club's membership book."

Peronist President Carlos Menem launched a crackdown on customs after police uncovered a huge customs racket last month estimated to have smuggled goods worth $10 billion into Argentina over the past four years.

Peronist Deputy Marcelo Stubrin said the aim of the probe was "to tidy up the Customs Office, put a stop to smuggling and help the government take steps to stop Argentina's borders looking like a sieve."
